analytical_observations.finding: The signed core restricted to Z=0 is strictly positive when uv!=0 because its three packet rows have determinant -uv. Positive event packets preserve this. The nonnegative full determinant from balanced weighted AM-GM then gives a nonnegative scalar Schur complement.

The matrix is polynomial and separately of degree at most two in each angle. Continuity after bihomogenization includes axes and projective endpoints. This reasoning concerns the complete parent, with source t>=0.

D_t has degree two for every t>=0. The displayed nonzero resultants imply coprimality of its numerator and each other denominator. Clearing a finite relation and reducing modulo each D_t forces its scalar coefficient to vanish.

An arbitrary fixed finite function space has a finite-dimensional product span. Thus it cannot contain SOS certificates for every literal S_t. The conclusion is about these literal scalar remainders, not about all possible certificates of the parent.

M_t=M_0+t*Du*Dv*e_X e_X^T, and M_0 is PSD. Four components of its unique PSD square root applied to the state, plus sqrt(Du*Dv)*X, give five source-independent testing functions. The square root is semialgebraic through its defining polynomial and PSD conditions.

Neither the scalar obstruction nor the five-feature one-parameter family proves or disproves full-Q222 finite-lift existence or supplies a global feature atlas. The proof explicitly states this limitation.
